shared_elements: incised linear bands framing/encircling the surface
justification: Both surfaces carry only shallow incised linear ornament: A has nested rectangular frames enclosing a cross-like and anchor-like internal motif, while B shows a narrow encircling band with a zigzag/hatched line below the rim. The correspondence is limited to generic engraved lines and a band of pattern; A's enclosing frames with distinct central symbols have no counterpart on B, which has no figural or symbolic content at all.
